# Analytical Scientist Role

## Context
Serving as the technical link between raw chemical instrumentation and downstream computational analysis. This role centers on the high-throughput quantification, separation, and structural validation of small-molecule systems, organic compounds, and synthetic lipids.

## My Contribution
